title: Hot Smoked Flaked Mexican Salmon Street Corn
description: A buttery, crunchy, comforting Mexican dish featuring hot smoked flaked salmon, perfect for a dinner with friends or family. Inspired by the flavors of elote, this recipe is vegetarian-friendly and easy to make.

ingredients.name: hot smoked flaked salmon
ingredients.notes: look for smoked salmon with a firm texture and a rich flavor

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: melted butter adds a rich and creamy flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: grilled corn kernels
ingredients.notes: fresh corn is best, but frozen or canned works too

ingredients.name: fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: chopped cilantro adds a fresh and herbaceous flavor

ingredients.name: lime juice
ingredients.notes: fresh lime juice adds a bright and citrusy flavor

ingredients.name: ground cumin
ingredients.notes: ground cumin adds a warm and earthy flavor

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.notes: kosher salt enhances the flavors of the dish

ingredients.name: coarse black pepper
ingredients.notes: coarse black pepper adds a nice texture and flavor

ingredients.name: queso fresco crumbles
ingredients.notes: crumbled queso fresco adds a salty and creamy flavor

ingredients.name: crushed tortilla chips
ingredients.notes: crushed tortilla chips adds a crunchy texture to the dish

instructions: Preheat the stone bowl dolsot over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the hot smoked flaked salmon to the dolsot and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the unsalted butter to the dolsot and cook until melted, stirring constantly.
Add the grilled corn kernels, fresh cilantro, lime juice, ground cumin, kosher salt, and coarse black pepper to the dolsot and stir to combine.
Top the salmon mixture with queso fresco crumbles and crushed tortilla chips.
Serve the hot smoked flaked Mexican salmon street corn immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
